framework: AEM content pages (/en/c/...) + Angular eShop micro-frontend (/eshop/devices/...)

_provenance.crawled_by: claude (paced Playwright crawl, installed Google Chrome, 1500 ms between actions)
_provenance.method: Every selector in `selectors`, `step_grounding_rules` and the flows' canonical_steps was clicked or asserted on the live dev site and resolved to exactly one visible element, using the app's own sweepPage/uniqueXPath. Nothing here comes from a BRD.
_provenance.previous_host: devnew-sas.etisalat.ae -- returns 404 for /eshop since 2026-10-20; every route here is on devnew.eand.ae

cookie_overlay._note: Usercentrics renders inside an open shadow root on every first visit: buttons 'Accept All' and 'Manage my preferences'. Playwright CSS pierces it; XPath does not.

search_mechanism._note: The AEM header has no search box, and the eShop header's search (app-header-search, placeholder 'What are you looking for?') stays hidden at 1440px. The listing page's own Search box is the verified search.

cart.empty_cart_message: //*[normalize-space(text())="You don't have any items in your cart"]
cart.start_shopping: //*[normalize-space(.)='START SHOPPING' or normalize-space(.)='Start shopping'][self::a or self::button]

default_automation_boundary.automated_scope: Accessories landing -> Devices mega menu -> Tablets listing (search, sort, filter, Load more) -> iPad Pro product configuration (variants, payment plans, specs, stock state) -> Cart page.
default_automation_boundary.external_boundary: Live Payment Gateway (Credit Card / OTP). Add to cart fails server-side on dev (DEV-CART-01, 2026-10-20), so no case may expect an item in the cart.

generation_directives: 1. PRECONDITIONS: The user is on '{app_name}' (dev host https://devnew.eand.ae) with the Usercentrics cookie banner accepted. Never use devnew-sas.etisalat.ae or www.etisalat.ae.

2. TARGETS: Use the Target Selector given in the canonical steps verbatim as the step target; they were verified on the live dev site. Quote on-screen labels exactly as written in the selectors (e.g. 'Add to cart', 'Out of stock', 'Price (Low to High)', '512GB').

3. STOCK AND CART: Dev stock changes day to day (2026-10-20 older iPad Pro models were In stock; 2026-10-21 every Tablets SKU checked was Out of stock), and clicking 'Add to cart' fails server-side (DEV-CART-01). Never write a case that depends on a product being in stock or expects an item in the cart.

4. PRODUCT URLS: Open a product with the Direct Configuration URL of the form {product_configuration_url_template} using the ProductId and SkuId from the Knowledge Base, or click its listing card by productId.
5. LINKS: Several 'View All' accessory links on the Accessories page point to production (www.etisalat.ae). A case may assert such a link's href but must never follow it.
test_case_matrix: Navigation: Accessories page -> Devices mega menu -> Tablets listing.
Listing: product cards, Search, Sort by Price, Device Storage filter, Load more.
Product configuration: storage / connectivity / display glass / colour selection, payment plans, Specs tab, breadcrumb and Back.
Negative: out-of-stock SKU shows 'Out of stock' and disables 'Add to cart' and 'Checkout Now'.
Cart: empty cart message and START SHOPPING.

known_defects.what: 15 of the 21 'View All' sub-category links on the dev Accessories page point to production https://www.etisalat.ae/eshop/... instead of the dev host.

Listing shows 'Unable to load devices, please try again'; POST /b2c/eshop/getProductsByCategory returns 400 'Filter cannot be empty'. Accessory products (e.g. Huawei FreeClip 2) return browsable:false.

Most Tablets cards are bare SKU entries showing 'Or null Smiles Points' with no price; they open a configuration page with no payment plans. Only the iPad Pro M4 11-inch (prod2450055) and 13-inch (prod2450056) product cards are complete.
All 48 iPad Pro M4 SKUs report inStock:false; Add to cart, Checkout Now and payment-plan tabs are disabled.

POST /b2c/eshop/addToShoppingCartOneByOne returns 417 after ~10 s and the page shows 'Internal server error' (seen for 11" New iPad Pro Wi-Fi prod830189 and 12.9" New iPad Pro prod830194, both In stock). No case can reach a filled cart on dev until this is fixed.

known_defects.where: /eshop/devices/configuration opened directly (deep link, no listing visit first)
known_defects.what: The 'Tablets' breadcrumb leads to /eshop/devices/listing/smartphones?category=mobileDevices&subCategory=cat550037 instead of the Tablets listing. Reached from the Tablets listing, it returns to /eshop/devices/listing/tablets correctly.

The site's firewall occasionally answers a fresh browser session with 'The requested URL was rejected. Please consult with your administrator.' (seen on the Tablets listing after several back-to-back runs). Generated scripts retry such a navigation once after 8 s.
